messages:
maria: Bringing up SQ3B-int4 on staging — initial perf looks good on short prompts but long-form coherence drops vs fp16. Need to expand our reference set to stress long-context coherence and 'silent drift' hallucinations. TL;DR: propose adding 300 long-form seeds across domains, new label schema (coherence_break + hallucination_span), and labeler run next week.
omar: Ugh ok. Do we have concrete metrics showing the regression? numbers help ops + labelers plan. :thinking:
chloe: Also need to know dedupe/overlap rules — last time labelers got duplicates from seedbank it slowed down throughput. Can we do a fuzzier fingerprint?
ryan: Quick numbers from eval harness: for len>1024 tokens SQ3B-int4 coherence_F1 dropped 6.2 pts vs fp16 baseline; hallucination_rate +4.1% (sample N=1k, mixed web/docs). Latency +9% but cost down ~2.8x.
maria: thanks ryan. that's the regression I was worried about. Omar can you size labeler effort for 300 items (3-way label + qc)? estimate labeling + adjudication hours.
omar: If we do 300 seeds with 3-way + adjudication, rough estimate 60 labeler-hours + 12 adjudicator-hours + 6 ops hours for ingestion & deid. We can compress by using 2-way + spot adjudication to ~45 labeler-hours. Need clear instructions for coherence_break tagging.
chloe: Suggest adding explicit examples in the instructions: when to tag coherence_break vs hallucination_span. I'll draft doc. Also we should avoid sampling items that are near-duplicates of existing refset (fuzzy overlap).
maria: Agreed. I want more variety across domains — finance, medical QA, long emails, policy docs, how-to articles. Split: 40% technical, 20% customer support transcripts, 20% creative, 20% mixed-formal.
ryan: I'll run a stratified sample from the longprompt pool. SQL snippet: ```SELECT id, text FROM long_prompts WHERE length(tokens)>1024 AND domain IN ('technical','support','creative','policy') ORDER BY random() LIMIT 400;``` We'll filter and dedupe client-side.
omar: For dedupe, current exact-hash removes ~12% overlap. But because tokenizer v3 changed, exact hash misses near-duplicates. I propose we run a fuzzy-seq-hash pass and then hand-off top 500 flagged near-duplicates to a small curator batch.
chloe: Good call. Also include a 'context-trim' flag — some long prompts contain system preamble repeated across items; we should normalize those before hashing.
maria: New label schema (draft): tags = [coherence_ok, coherence_break, hallucination_span, incorrect_factual, out_of_scope]; metadata: domain, prompt_len_tokens, seed_origin, deid_status. Keep tags short for label UI.
omar: Can you put that into the labeler template? I'll plug it into the ops pipeline. Also: labeler-ops-bot, can you check labeler capacity for next Tue/Wed?
labeler-ops-bot: Upcoming capacity check: Tue 09:00 — available labeler-hours = 80; Wed 09:00 — available labeler-hours = 60. Current backlog: 120h. ETA to clear backlog + this job (2-way) = 6 days.
ryan: Since we only need 300 final seeds, I'll over-sample to 400 and mark ~100 as holdout. Helps keep variance low. We'll hand pick 50 edgecases for extra adjudication.
chloe: I'll write the instruction doc and a 10-example quick guide. Will include 6 positive coherence examples, 6 coherence_break edgecases, and 8 hallucination_span examples.
maria: Plan + owners: ryan -> sampling + initial dedupe (today), chloe -> labeling guide + examples (today), omar -> ops scheduling + ingestion template (EOD), me -> evaluation harness run and thresholding + final refset merge (Fri). Action: everyone ack and any blockers? :rocket:
omar: Ack from me. main blocker: need the fuzzy hashing script. can ry run or share?
ryan: I'll push fuzzy-hash branch and a small CLI. Usage: `python fuzzhash.py --input csv --out fuzzy_flags.csv --threshold 0.78`. Will tag PR in #eng-ml.
maria: Perfect. Also note: we'll add an eval column to the refset csv: 'sensitivity_group' (long_coherence_test). That way we can run quick canaries on future quant builds.
chloe: One more ask — add a rule to avoid sampling from any user-uploaded content buckets for privacy. ryan, can you filter that in SQL?
ryan: yep, `AND source NOT IN ('user_upload','private_bucket')` added.
maria: Great. If no other blockers I'll start the harness runs after ryan's sample arrives. Thanks team.
omar: +1. I'll queue labelers for Tue.
labeler-ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: labeler batch queued for Tue 09:00 (300 seeds, 2-way labeling). Auto-notify to assigned labelers at Tue 08:50.
chloe: Draft done — sending link in thread (doc: /docs/refset-longcoherence-instructions.md). Please review before EOD.
maria: Closing loop: expected timeline — sampling/dedupe today, docs + template today, label run Tue-Wed, adjudication Thu, merge Fri. Will post final metrics after merge. Thanks! :white_check_mark:
